{{TournamentPageStart|twitchid=lcs|toclimit=2|text=The '''LCS 2024 Summer Season''' is the second split of the eleventh year of North America's professional League of Legends league. Eight teams compete in a round robin group stage.}}

==Overview==
=== Format ===
* 8 teams participate
* Single Round Robin
* Matches are best of three
* Top six teams qualify for [[LCS/2024 Season/Championship|Championship]]
** Top 2 teams start in the upper bracket Round 2
** 3rd to 6th start in the upper bracket Round 1
